description: Manages system-wide access control, user roles, and granular permissions for various entities and routes.

endpoints.name: GetSystemPermissionConfiguration
endpoints.description: Retrieves the complete system-wide permission configuration, including all defined roles and their associated capabilities. This endpoint is primarily used for initializing frontend applications with the necessary access control information.
example_uses: Get the full list of permissions for the entire system.
Retrieve all roles and their capabilities.
Show me the system's permission structure.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve the comprehensive permission configuration for the entire system, typically for initial setup or display of all available roles and their capabilities.

endpoints.name: CheckUserRoutePermission
endpoints.description: Checks if the currently authenticated user has the necessary permissions to access a specified route or page. Returns detailed permission information, including whether access is granted and any specific permissions associated with that route.

route.description: The route/URL path to check permissions for (e.g., '/partnerships/contacts/123')

example_uses: Check if I can access the '/partners' page.
Verify my permissions for the '/admin/users' route.
Can I view the details of contact ID 123?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to dynamically verify if the current user has access to a particular application route or page before attempting to navigate or display content.

endpoints.name: GetEntityPermissionDetails
endpoints.description: Retrieves the full permission configuration for a specified entity type (e.g., 'Contact', 'Partner'). This includes all possible operations that can be performed on the entity and the roles required for each operation.
example_uses: What permissions are needed for 'Contact' entities?
Show me the access rules for 'Partner' objects.
Retrieve all operations and required roles for 'Interaction' entities.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to understand the granular permission requirements for specific business entities, such as 'Contact' or 'Partner', to determine what actions are allowed and by whom.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieves the roles and basic permission information assigned to the currently authenticated user. This provides an overview of the user's access level within the system.
example_uses: What roles do I currently have?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to quickly determine the roles and basic permissions of the currently logged-in user.

endpoints.name: GetUserRolesByUserId
endpoints.description: Retrieves the roles and basic information for a specific user identified by their ID. This endpoint typically requires administrative privileges to access other users' details.

userId.description: The ID of the user to retrieve role information for

example_uses: Show me the role assignments for user ID '789'.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint (with appropriate administrative access) to look up the roles and basic information for any specific user in the system.

endpoints.name: GetAvailableSystemRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieves a comprehensive list of all predefined roles available within the system, along with their descriptions and associated metadata.
example_uses: List all roles defined in the system.
Show me the available user roles.
What are the different types of roles I can assign?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a complete list of all possible roles that can be assigned to users or used in permission configurations.
